blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) had issued a show-cause order (SCO) on Thursday (November 19) against a female motorcycle rider who allegedly performed dangerous stunts along Molino Boulevard. The area is a public road in Cavite’s Bacoor City. “Based on a video received by the agency, the rider was seen overtaking a group of big motorcycles while standing on her moving motorcycle,” the LTO said in a post on its official Facebook page. “Such a dangerous maneuver could endanger the rider and other road users,” it noted.
